newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise squeezed higher in stock shortage.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise squeezed higher in stock shortage.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc rocketed on Wednesday as a resurgence of buying interest caught the market short of stock, dealers said.
"Oils have been strong recently and Enterprise is not like BP or Shell where there is a big free float," said one dealer. "If there are a couple of decent buyers it
Enterprise shares were up 22p at 668-1/2 by 0916 GMT in trade of 896,010 shares.
Other shares in the oil exploration sector were also strong with Cairn Energy Plc up 22p at 600-1/2 and Lasmo Plc up 4p at 260.
BP was unchanged at 709-1/2 and Shell was up 5p at 10.94-1/2.
Oil stocks have been boosted this week by sterling's fall against the dollar, which boosts the sterling value of the profits companies make in the dollar-denominated international oil trade.
There has also been talk that crude oil prices are bottoming out from recent declines, analysts said.
